# 2026.3.7-alpha-2 — Magento Headless Code Engine (alpha)

**Prerelease / early-access testing.** This build packages the Magento 2 and Adobe Commerce desktop IDE plugin and an independent JetBrains Headless Code Engine (HCE) plugin. HCE exposes Magento MCP tools to AI agents without a desktop IDE session.

## Install HCE with one command

From the root of a Magento checkout (the directory containing `composer.json`), run:

```sh
installer=$(mktemp) && curl -fLsS 'https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/releases/download/2026.3.7-alpha-2/magento-hce.pyz' -o "$installer" && python3 "$installer" setup --client codex
```

Use `--client claude` for Claude Code. This setup checks the HCE runtime and plugin integrity, offers JetBrains sign-in when necessary, indexes the current checkout, verifies Magento module lookup, and registers the selected MCP client.

**Requirements:** Linux x86-64 or Apple Silicon macOS, Python 3.12+, a JetBrains license valid for the pinned HCE runtime, and an existing Magento checkout with Composer dependencies. The first run downloads and configures HCE; allow for indexing. See the [HCE guide](https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/blob/5.4.0-develop/modules/hce/README.md#install-on-a-development-host) for configuration and troubleshooting.

## Desktop IDE plugin — install from JetBrains Marketplace

To use this alpha in PhpStorm / WebStorm, add the [Magento Marketplace alpha repository](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugins/alpha/8024) in **Settings → Plugins → Manage Plugin Repositories**, then install **Magento 2 and Adobe Commerce** from Marketplace. Use this distribution route for actual Marketplace-tracked IDE plugin downloads, rather than manually downloading the desktop ZIP from GitHub.

**Download-count distinction:** HCE is a **different plugin** (`com.magento.idea.magento2plugin.hce`). Its installer currently downloads `magento-hce.zip` from this GitHub release, which **does not increment Marketplace download statistics**. Counting HCE downloads in Marketplace requires first creating/approving its own Marketplace listing and then switching the launcher build to its existing `--marketplace` download mode. Do not confuse the desktop Marketplace package (8024) with the HCE archive.

## Feedback and limitations

HCE currently supports Magento project configuration, CLI environment discovery, maintenance checks, XML diagnostics and inspection, bundled agent skills, and read-only Magerun metadata. Desktop-only PHP analysis, upgrade compatibility, and scaffolding are not available in HCE. This is an alpha; report setup/agent integration problems in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/magento/magento2-phpstorm-plugin/issues).
